name: Delhi High Court Main Gate (Gate No. 1)
description: Primary entrance from Sher Shah Road for visitors and advocates
accessibilityNotes: Ground level entry with security checkpoint; vehicle drop-off area nearby

name: Gate No. 2 (Lawyers Gate)
description: Dedicated entry for advocates with valid Bar Association ID
accessibilityNotes: Ground level entry; separate pedestrian path

name: Gate No. 7 (School Block Side)
description: Alternative entry from the School Block side
accessibilityNotes: Ground level; less crowded during peak hours

name: Main Court Building (Old Block)
description: Original High Court building housing courtrooms, administrative offices, and the Registrar General's office
accessibilityNotes: Historic building; ground floor accessible via main entrance. Upper floors: elevator reported but operational status requires on-site confirmation

name: New Courts Block (C Block)
description: Modern block with 15 courtrooms across 4 floors and 9 Registrars' Courts on ground floor. Designed by Design Forum International
accessibilityNotes: Modern construction with ramp access at ground level; elevators to upper floors reported available

name: S Block
description: Newest building inaugurated in December 2022 with additional courtrooms and modern facilities
accessibilityNotes: Modern building; accessible entrance with ramp reported. Elevator access to all floors

name: Lawyers Chambers Block I
description: First block of advocates' chambers with individual offices for practicing lawyers
accessibilityNotes: Ground floor accessible; upper floor access varies by section

name: Lawyers Chambers Block II
description: Second block of advocates' chambers with additional office space
accessibilityNotes: Ground floor accessible; narrow corridors in some sections

name: Bar Library
description: Library facility maintained by the Delhi High Court Bar Association for advocates' reference and study
accessibilityNotes: Ground floor entrance accessible; reading rooms on multiple levels

name: High Court Canteen & Cafeteria
description: Dining facility serving advocates, staff, and visitors within the court complex

name: Filing Counter & Registry
description: Counter for filing cases, petitions, and legal documents with the court registry
accessibilityNotes: Ground floor; accessible counter height reported

name: Visitor Parking Area
description: Multi-level parking facility near the main entrance for visitors and advocates
accessibilityNotes: Accessible parking spots near entrance reported; elevator to court level

name: Central Courtyard Junction
description: Central open courtyard connecting the Old Building, C Block, and Lawyers Chambers

name: North Corridor Junction
description: Connecting point between C Block, S Block, and the northern court complex

name: South Walkway Junction
description: Junction near Lawyers Chambers and the Canteen area

name: Delhi High Court Mediation Centre
description: Facility for alternative dispute resolution and court-annexed mediation services
accessibilityNotes: Ground floor accessible; separate accessible entrance reported
